About the job

At TechnologyOne, our goal is to simplify life for our customers and help them succeed in an ever-changing world. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our Brisbane team.




In this role, you will join our Local Government team and help shape GUIDE for Residents, our intelligent digital experience for how residents' access and complete council services. You will build modern cloud and mobile experiences across web, Android and iPhone using React, TypeScript and C#, alongside a high-performing, collaborative team. 




If you enjoy working on complex systems, writing clean and maintainable code, and using AI, coding agents to enhance your development workflow, this role offers a chance to do work that matters within a supportive and high-performing team.




What you'll be doing:

Build and maintain resident-facing mobile experiences for Android and iPhone, alongside responsive web experiences.
Deliver mobile features using native or cross-platform technologies, with a strong understanding of Android and iOS platform conventions.
Integrate mobile experiences with secure cloud services, APIs, authentication, notifications, and device capabilities.
Build modern cloud-native solutions using React, TypeScript and C#.
Design and develop intuitive user experiences that solve real customer problems.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Designers and Engineers to deliver valuable product outcomes.
Contribute to technical design, experimentation and proof-of-concepts.
Contribute to mobile quality practices, including unit, integration, UI and device testing across supported Android and iOS versions.
Develop and maintain automated tests, including UI automation using Playwright where appropriate.
Champion quality through testing, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
Apply resident-centred design principles to create simple, accessible and trustworthy experiences for diverse communities.
Work across conversational, transactional and mobile journeys so residents can move seamlessly between channels without losing context.
Develop deep product knowledge and contribute ideas that improve customer outcomes.




Your Talents…

A genuine passion for software development and agile ways of working, with the curiosity to take on new challenges.
Experience using AI coding agents as part of the software development lifecycle, with an understanding of how to effectively leverage them to improve development outcomes.
A focus on writing clean, high-quality code and continuously improving your craft.
Hands-on experience developing and shipping mobile applications for Android and iOS (iPhone).
Experience with modern mobile development technologies such as React Native, Kotlin, Swift, or equivalent cross-platform frameworks.
Understanding mobile application architecture, secure API integration, authentication, push notifications, accessibility, and responsive design.
Experience with mobile testing, release pipelines, app signing, and deployment through the Apple App Store and Google Play is highly desirable.
Strong software development skills in C#, React, TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL.
Experience building modern web applications and customer-facing digital experiences.
Working knowledge of SQL and data-driven application development.
Experience with AWS cloud technologies is desirable.
Experience with automated testing practices, including UI automation using Playwright or similar frameworks, is highly desirable.
Excellent problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
The ability to thrive working both independently and as part of a team.
Confidence using tools such as Git, Rider, JIRA and Confluence.
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
Based in Brisbane, or willing and able to relocate to Brisbane for the role.




Benefits… 

Competitive remuneration package
Industry leading employee share plan
Amazing Culture: 8 x Australian Business Awards "Employer of Choice" winner
We love our team events & celebrate diversity
Flexible hours: we are family-friendly and value life outside of work
Free gym membership in your region (or, if you are located at HQ, we have a new state of the art Gym onsite, exclusive and available 24/7).
Additional 2.5 days of leave per year dedicated to volunteering at a charity of your choice
Free breakfast and coffee on-site
Defined career framework - know what options you have in your career path and how you can get there




Why Join Us?




At TechnologyOne, we value diversity, inclusion, and creating a supportive environment where our people can grow. We offer career development opportunities, competitive salaries, recognition, and a culture that encourages creativity and innovation.




Who We Are




TechnologyOne (ASX: TNE) is Australia's largest enterprise software company, delivering a global SaaS ERP platform used by over 1,200 organisations across government, education, and enterprise. For 38 years, we've helped customers simplify their operations through technology that evolves with their needs.

About the company

TechnologyOne

42,932 followers

Follow

Software Development

 • 

1001-5000 employees

 • 

1,592 on LinkedIn

TechnologyOne is here to make life simple for our community. As Australia’s largest enterprise SaaS company, we provide a deeply integrated solution for more than 1,300 leading corporations, government agencies, local councils and universities across Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom.  

Our strong partnerships with our customers could not be possible without the grit, determination, innovation and creativity of our more than 1,300-strong team in offices located across six countries.  

From our humble beginnings in a demountable office at a hide processing plant in Hemmant, Brisbane more than 36 years ago, TechnologyOne has provided customers enterprise software that evolves and adapts to new and emerging technologies, allowing them to focus on their business and not technology. 

The next evolution in our innovation is Solution-as-as-Service (SaaS Plus). We are leveraging our unique domain experience and our unwavering commitment to the industries we serve by taking complete responsibility to deliver outcomes with our best-in-class SaaS ERP. With SaaS Plus, TechnologyOne takes full responsibility for the complete outcome of the solution experience, not just the software. 

Learn more about TechnologyOne: https://www.technology1.com//

Oliver Jarman

 
 • 2nd

Presales Director @ TechnologyOne | Leading Pre-Sales and Bid Teams

3d

Proud of what we’ve achieved through two days of collaboration across our Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Supply Chain Management (SCM) solutions at TechnologyOne.

The workshop brought together colleagues from Product and Presales to share insights, deepen our understanding of our solutions, and translate product capability into compelling demonstrations of customer value.

What made this workshop particularly valuable was the journey from product insight to demonstration excellence, connecting what our solutions do with why it matters to our customers, the challenges they face, and the outcomes they want to achieve.

We’ve also taken an important step forward in establishing shared Product and Presales principles that will help us consistently uncover, articulate and demonstrate the value of our solutions. This is about more than showcasing features. It’s about telling a stronger story around customer challenges, business outcomes and the difference our solutions can make.

A big thank you to Gladstone Brohier, and everyone from Product and Presales who contributed their expertise, energy and ideas. The collaboration and commitment across the two days have been fantastic.

I’m excited to build on this momentum and see these workshops rolled out across all our product groups in the future. The opportunity to bring our teams closer together, strengthen our collective capability and elevate how we demonstrate customer value is significant.

Simone D.

 • 3rd+

Product and customer success leader, driving technology adoption and operational excellence across universities and TAFE/VET through practical, people‑centered solutions.

5d • Edited

After many, many months of planning, customer conversations, shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, celebrating breakthroughs, and working through countless details, I am incredibly excited that our TechnologyOne Class Scheduler Prove Program officially kicks off on 9 November.
For me personally, this has been a genuine labour of love. What started as a vision to reimagine the scheduling experience for higher education has become a product shaped by decades of scheduling expertise, close collaboration with customers, and an unwavering focus on solving some of the most complex scheduling challenges faced by institutions today.
TechnologyOne's continued investment in Class Scheduler delivers a purpose-built, next-generation scheduling solution that helps education institutions produce higher-quality timetables faster, reduce manual effort, and respond confidently to change through intelligent automation, powerful optimisation, and a modern user experience.
What excites me most is that we are now entering the next phase of the journey. Over the coming months, we will be partnering closely with institutions across ANZ and the UK, learning together, testing together, and ensuring we deliver a solution that genuinely transforms the scheduling experience for higher education.
A huge thank you to our customers who have chosen to come on this journey with us, and to the incredible people across TechnologyOne who have helped bring this vision to life. I am looking forward to what we can achieve together.
Here's to the next chapter.
#TechnologyOne #ClassScheduler #HigherEducation #Scheduling #Timetabling #EdTech #ProductManagement #Innovation

Wow! The Victorian P&R Insights session has broken records again!

Always well attended, and this year was no different, with a 𝟱𝟬% 𝗶𝗻𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘁 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝟭𝟱𝟬 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲𝘀 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘂𝘀. With such strong interest, we even had to make a very quick change of location to Ormond Hall!

As always, our sessions are an open forum, where every question is welcomed and every question asked gets answered. The depth of council members experience and knowledge in the room continues to drive new ideas and innovation, helping take P&R to even greater heights.  Topics covered included 𝗩𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗮 𝗥𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝘀 (𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀, 𝗥𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲 & 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴), 𝗡𝗮𝗺𝗲, 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘆 & 𝗥𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 & 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝗻 𝗔𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲.

A special shout-out to Henriette From and Tarrant Mathews, who made a great tandem team throughout the day, bringing P&R to life with live demos and showcasing what’s possible and what is to come. 

And a huge thank you to everyone who took time away from supporting their communities to join us. The payback is huge with skills, experiences and knowledge shared across the P&R community.

Thanks again to everyone who made the session such a success!  🙌

Kieran Watson

 
 • 3rd+

Driving digital transformation in the Higher Education sector

2w

Who said understanding the challenges facing Higher Education had to be boring?!

This week at the Education Strategy Forum, Reza Mosavian , Joe Hill and I took a slightly different approach to understanding what’s really keeping the sector awake at night…

We hosted our very own TechnologyOne Higher Education Game Show! 🎉

Armed with a giant wheel of fortune, yellow jackets, a stopwatch, some fantastic prizes and absolutely no shortage of competitive spirit, we challenged delegates to share the biggest challenges and priorities facing their institutions.

From AI & Automation and Data & Insight, through to Financial Resilience, Student Experience and the ever-present challenge of doing less with less, the wheel certainly gave us plenty to talk about!

The best part? It wasn’t just about having a bit of fun (although there was plenty of that 😄). It gave us a really interesting and honest insight into the issues universities are dealing with right now and, more importantly, what they see as the priorities for the future.

A huge thanks to everyone who got involved, spun the wheel and shared their experiences.

Higher Education is facing some big questions. Sometimes the best way to start answering them is simply to ask the people living them every day.

#HigherEducation #EducationStrategyForum #EdTech #Universities #AI #DigitalTransformation #TechnologyOne #GameShow TechnologyOne

Edward Chung

 
 • 2nd

Managing Director & CEO at TechnologyOne

2w

That’s a wrap on FY26 at TechnologyOne. And what a year it's been!

We began the year on the road with our ANZ Showcase tour, introducing Plus and sharing our vision for the next chapter of enterprise software. We closed the year with the launch of TechnologyOne Now, a new way to connect with our customer community, and a chance to introduce Guide for students, our latest agentic AI innovation designed to transform the student experience.

But FY26 was about much more than that.

Across all regions, our people partnered with customers, supported one another, volunteered in local communities, and kept raising the bar on what we can achieve together. Every release delivered, customer projects completed, support ticket resolved, event hosted, and community initiative supported contributes to our mission of making life simple for our community.

As we reflect on the year, I'm incredibly proud of what we've achieved together. Thank you to every member of the TechnologyOne team for your passion, commitment, and relentless focus on our customers. Your efforts help organisations deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve, and that's something worth celebrating.

Thank you also to our customers, partners, and the broader TechnologyOne community for your trust, feedback, and support throughout the year.

We're excited for what lies ahead in FY27.

#LifeAtTechOne #EOFY #TechnologyOne

Simone D.

 • 3rd+

Product and customer success leader, driving technology adoption and operational excellence across universities and TAFE/VET through practical, people‑centered solutions.

2w • Edited

What does the future of university scheduling look like? Well, we are about to find out, directly from the experts.
Over the next 12 months, our global Scheduling team will be on the road, visiting universities and partners across:
📍 Bradford
📍 Cardiff
📍 London
📍 St Andrews
📍 Ulster  
📍Adelaide 
📍 Brisbane 
📍 Hobart 
📍 Melbourne 
📍 Perth 
📍 Sydney 
📍 Auckland 
📍 Otago 
📍 Waikato 
📍 Wellington
These visits are about much more than showcasing software. As specialists in both class scheduling and exam scheduling, we believe the best solutions are built alongside the people who use them every day. By spending time directly with our university communities, we will be listening to real-world challenges, understanding evolving requirements, sharing product innovations, and gathering valuable feedback that shapes our future roadmap.
One of the strengths of TechnologyOne scheduling solutions is that they have been designed and refined through close collaboration with institutions and genuine scheduling experts. From product design and development through to implementation, our approach has always been guided by the experience and expertise of the people who live and breathe scheduling every day.
We are excited to continue these conversations across our regions, learn from our customers, and demonstrate how our ongoing investment in scheduling is helping universities optimise teaching delivery, improve resource utilisation, and create better outcomes for students and staff.
We look forward to seeing many of you over the coming year.
